name: Notes folder to tasks
summary: Turn new or changed meeting notes in a folder into proposed tasks and follow-ups.

routes.how: Read the local board and source files

flow.title: Once a day
flow.text: Runs on the shared automation schedule.

flow.title: Read your notes folder
flow.text: Only the folder you choose when you install it.

flow.title: Find new or changed notes
flow.text: A small script compares file fingerprints with what it saw before. No AI is used.

flow.title: Pull out actions
flow.text: An agent reads each note and matches people and cards already on the board.

flow.title: Review Inbox
flow.text: Tasks and follow-ups wait there as proposals for you to accept.
